title: Add Built-in Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduces a declarative request validation layer using JSON schemas, allowing developers to define and enforce payload shapes per route. This prevents malformed data from reaching handlers, reduces boilerplate, and improves security and reliability.
testCases: Valid request body passes and reaches the handler
Invalid request body returns 400 with detailed error messages
Missing required fields are reported correctly
Nested object validation works as defined in schema
acceptance: When a route registers a validation schema, incoming requests are automatically validated; valid requests proceed to the next middleware/handler, while invalid requests receive a 400 response with a JSON error payload describing all violations. The middleware must not interfere with existing routes that do not specify a schema.
reason: Ensures data integrity at the edge of the application, reduces repetitive validation code, and aligns yantraverse with modern API best practices, making it more attractive for production use.
